import os,json,hashlib
os.environ.setdefault("DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE","core.settings")
import django
django.setup()
from django.db import connection,transaction
from django.db.migrations.executor import MigrationExecutor
from django.apps import apps
from django.conf import settings
from pathlib import Path
from apps.data_center.infrastructure.publication_models import CanonicalPublicationModel,PublicationMemberModel,CoverageSnapshotModel
from django.db.models import Count,Min,Max,Q
keys=["equity.quote.snapshot","equity.price.bar","equity.valuation.fact","equity.financial.fact"]
with transaction.atomic():
 with connection.cursor() as c:
  c.execute("SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL REPEATABLE READ, READ ONLY")
  c.execute("SELECT current_setting('transaction_read_only'),current_setting('transaction_isolation'),transaction_timestamp()")
  tx=c.fetchone()
 executor=MigrationExecutor(connection)
 migrations=sorted((a,n) for a,n in executor.loader.applied_migrations)
 result={"transaction":tx,"build_identity":json.loads(Path(settings.AGOM_BUILD_IDENTITY_PATH).read_text()),"release_manifest":json.loads(Path(settings.AGOM_RELEASE_MANIFEST_PATH).read_text()),"applied_migration_count":len(migrations),"pending_migrations":[[m.app_label,m.name,backward] for m,backward in executor.migration_plan(executor.loader.graph.leaf_nodes())],"migration_graph_sha256":hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(migrations,separators=(",",":")).encode()).hexdigest(),"datasets":{}}
 for key in keys:
  qs=CanonicalPublicationModel.objects.filter(dataset_key=key)
  current=list(qs.filter(publication_key="current",state="published").values("publication_id","dataset_key","publication_key","publication_hash","state","member_count","coverage_requested_count","coverage_selected_count","coverage_missing_count","as_of","published_at","must_not_use_for_decision","blocked_reason"))
  for p in current:
   members=PublicationMemberModel.objects.filter(publication_id=p["publication_id"])
   p["members"]=members.aggregate(count=Count("pk"),missing_observed_at=Count("pk",filter=Q(observed_at__isnull=True)),oldest=Min("observed_at"),newest=Max("observed_at"))
   p["member_fact_tables"]=list(members.values("fact_table").annotate(count=Count("pk")))
   p["coverage_snapshots"]=list(CoverageSnapshotModel.objects.filter(publication_id=p["publication_id"]).values())
  result["datasets"][key]={"all_publication_count":qs.count(),"current_published":current}
 result["fact_model_schema"]={m.__name__:{"table":m._meta.db_table,"fields":[f.name for f in m._meta.fields]} for m in apps.get_app_config("data_center").get_models() if m.__name__ in ("QuoteSnapshot","PriceBar","ValuationSnapshot","FinancialFact","AssetMaster")}
 print(json.dumps(result,default=str,sort_keys=True))
